decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1/The proposed erection of a second floor extension to form an additional  
  floor and roof terrace at first floor level, replacement of existing single 
  storey garage / utility room to form shower/ wc / utility and reception 
  room would by reason of its size, position and appearance be unduly 
  dominant and out of character with the house.   The proposal would fail 
  to preserve or enhance the Spring Grove Conservation Area and is 
  contrary to the Policy ENV1.1 (New Development) ENVB 1.2  (High 
  Buildings or structures affecting sensitive areas) and ENVB 2.2 
  (Conservation Areas)  of the Unitary  Development Plan. 
.
2/  The proposed creation of an additional floor would, by  reason of  its size, position and appearance  in relation to  neighbouring residential properties, be unduly dominant, out of scale  with the house and the character of the area, harmful to the living 
conditions  of adjoining residents and is contrary to the Policies ENVB 
1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations) of the   
 Unitary Development Plan and Supplementary Planning Guidance,  
 Residential Extension Guidelines.     

3/  The proposed creation of an additional floor will lead to additional 
      windows causing overlooking and loss of privacy detrimental to the 
      amenity of the adjoining residents is contrary to the Policies  ENVB 1.1 (New        Development) of the Unitary Development  Plan.     

4/  Loss of off-street parking  as a result of the proposal would be likely to   
     give rise to conditions prejudicial to the free flow of traffic in the 
         immediate vicinity and be detrimental to the amenities of the area.   The 
         proposal is therefore contrary to  policy  T 1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking 
         and Servicing Facilities for Developments), of the  Unitary Development 
         Plan.
description: Erection of a second floor extension to form additional floor and roof terrace to first floor level, replacement of existing single storey garage/utility room to form shower/wc/utility and reception room to existing dwellinghouse.
